---
title: "DB vs In-Memory"
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

Create sample dataset
```{r}
n_rows <- 5000000
set.seed(42)

ds <- data.frame(
  customer_id = sample(1:50000, n_rows, replace = TRUE),
  region      = sample(c("North", "South", "East", "West"), n_rows, replace = TRUE),
  q1_sales    = runif(n_rows, 10, 500),
  q2_sales    = runif(n_rows, 10, 500),
  q3_sales    = runif(n_rows, 10, 500),
  q4_sales    = runif(n_rows, 10, 500)
)
head(ds)
```


Setup DuckDB
```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "ds", ds)

db_ds <- dplyr::tbl(con, "ds")
```


dplyr function
```{r}
im_fun <- function() {
  ds |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("q"),
      names_to = "quarter",
      values_to = "amount"
    ) |>
    filter(amount > 100) |>
    group_by(region, quarter) |>
    summarise(
      total_sales = sum(amount),
      avg_sales   = mean(amount),
      .groups     = "drop"
    )
}
```

SQL function
```{r}
sql_fun <- function() {
  db_ds |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("q"),
      names_to = "quarter",
      values_to = "amount"
    ) |>
    filter(amount > 100) |>
    group_by(region, quarter) |>
    summarise(
      total_sales = sum(amount),
      avg_sales   = mean(amount),
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) |>
    collect()
}
```


```{r}
bench::mark(
  in_memory = im_fun(),
  sql = sql_fun(),
  iterations = 5,
  check = FALSE
) |> 
  select(Approach = expression, "Median Time" = median, Memory = mem_alloc)
```
